name: TerribleTruth
source:
Terrible Truth is not just a single story — it is an anthology where everyday life meets mysticism, science collides with fantasy, and horror exists alongside comedy.

Experience the story of Parfiriy — a Siberian shaman who stands guard between worlds — and his spirit companion, the fox Flap.

Only your choices will determine what this story becomes:
a warm, cozy New Year’s tale about family,
a detective story,
or a mystical thriller.

[From [url=https://agarey.itch.io/terribletruth]itch.io[/url]]
